title: Microsoft Teams: shared call history in the Queues app on mobile
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap record, Microsoft's tenant notice and the cited Learn documentation. Both control paths and commands are documented, and the briefing explicitly acknowledges Microsoft's conflicting instructions about the template-assignment tab.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans shared call history in the Queues app on Teams mobile.
claims.quote: Calling reps and Supervisor leads can view shared call history for their call queues in the Queues app on Mobile

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development"

claims.where: front matter: targetDate; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap target is December CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "December CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap record supplies no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.claim: The release phase is General Availability.

claims.claim: Microsoft's notice says Worldwide rollout begins in early December 2026.
claims.quote: General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in early December 2026 and is expected to complete by mid-December 2026.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Representatives and supervisors with access to shared call history are the affected users.
claims.quote: Representatives and supervisors with access to shared call history in the Queues app, which is included with a Teams Premium license.

claims.claim: Authorized representatives can see missed, answered, outgoing and voicemail calls across their queue.
claims.quote: Authorized representatives can view shared call history across their call queue, including missed, answered, outgoing, and voicemail calls.

claims.claim: Users can filter shared call history by resolution status.
claims.quote: Users can filter call history by resolution status to identify calls that need attention.

claims.claim: Tapping a call reveals its caller, call type, time, and voicemail or forwarding information.
claims.quote: Users can tap a call to view details, including the caller, call type, time, voicemail or forwarding information, and a timeline of the call's progression through the queue.

claims.claim: Call details include a timeline of the call's progression through the queue.
claims.quote: Users can tap a call to view details, including the caller, call type, time, voicemail or forwarding information, and a timeline of the call's progression through the queue.

claims.claim: The system automatically marks missed calls as Unresolved.
claims.quote: The system automatically marks missed calls as Unresolved, allowing representatives to identify customers who need follow-up.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Mobile users can change missed-call statuses to In progress or Resolved.
claims.quote: Users can change missed call statuses to In progress or Resolved.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: All queue members with shared call history access can see an updated missed-call status.
claims.quote: All queue members with access to shared call history can see the updated status, who made the change, and when.

claims.claim: Queue members with access can see who changed a status and when.
claims.quote: All queue members with access to shared call history can see the updated status, who made the change, and when.

claims.claim: Users without shared call history enabled continue to see only personal call history.
claims.quote: Users without shared call history enabled will continue to see only their personal call history.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Risk assessment
claims.claim: The mobile change is on automatically for eligible users whose organization already uses shared call history.
claims.quote: If your organization already uses shared call history, eligible users will automatically receive the mobile experience.

claims.claim: Microsoft requires no new administrative action for this rollout.
claims.quote: No new administrative action is required for this rollout.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends informing call queue representatives about the mobile experience and updating missed-call statuses.
claims.quote: We recommend that you inform call queue representatives about the new mobile experience, particularly how to update missed call statuses to avoid duplicate follow-ups.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Organizations can enable shared call history by creating a template in Teams admin center and assigning it to call queues.
claims.quote: If shared call history is not enabled, you can enable it in the Teams admin center by creating a Shared Call History template and assigning it to your call queues.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Mobile shared call history uses the same administrative settings as the desktop experience.
claims.quote: Shared call history on mobile uses the same administrative settings as the desktop experience.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Scope
claims.claim: Administrators can grant access to all queue members or restrict it to authorized users.
claims.quote: You can grant access to all queue members or restrict access to authorized users.

claims.quote: Representatives and supervisors with access to shared call history in the Queues app, which is included with a Teams Premium license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Risk assessment; Cost and licensing

claims.quote: Users must have a Teams Phone and a Teams Premium license to use Queues app.

claims.claim: Every Queues app user requires a Teams Premium licence.
claims.quote: All Queues App users require a Teams Premium license.

claims.claim: The shared call history planning page lists Auto Attendant and Call Queue licensing and Queues App licensing as requirements.
claims.quote:
## Licensing requirements

- [Auto Attendant and Call Queue](aa-cq-reference-prerequisites-licensing#base-licensing)
- [Queues App](aa-cq-reference-prerequisites-licensing#queues-app)

claims.claim: Auto Attendant and Call Queue base licensing requires at least one Teams Phone licence.
claims.quote: At least one Teams Phone license to enable Teams Phone Agent, Auto Attendant, and Call Queue services.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The record and notice name no separate mobile licence or charge, and the cited pages publish no mobile-specific price or meter.
claims.quote: Searched: "shared call history" "mobile" licensing price meter Teams Premium. Read the record, MC1556098, and cited Learn planning, setup, licensing, Queues app and cmdlet pages; no separate mobile licence, price or meter found.

claims.claim: A shared call history template defines the history categories available and who can see them.
claims.quote: A Shared Call History template defines the type of call queue history that's available and who can see it.

claims.claim: Both call queue permission parameters accept None, AuthorizedUsersOnly and AuthorizedUsersAndAgents.
claims.quote: Supported values: None | AuthorizedUsersOnly | AuthorizedUsersAndAgents

claims.claim: AuthorizedUsersAndAgents exposes the selected call category to representatives as well as authorized users.
claims.quote: This example creates a new Shared Call History template where incoming missed calls for Call Queue are shown to authorized users and agents and, answered and outbound calls are shown to authorized users only.

claims.claim: Shared call history includes missed calls, shared voicemails, call status, call times and duration, and call participants.
claims.quote:
Shared voicemails.
- Status of each call log, whether it's in-progress, resolved, or unresolved.
- Call times and duration.
- Call participants.

claims.claim: Conference mode must be enabled for the shared call history template parameter to apply.
claims.quote:
The SharedCallQueueHistoryTemplateId parameter indicates the Shared Call History template to apply to the call queue.

Note

`-ConferenceMode` must be set to $true

claims.claim: Shared call history is unavailable when a Teams channel is used for queue membership.
claims.quote:
Shared call history is not availble when using a Teams channel for queue membership

- `-ChannelId` and `-ChannelUserObjectId` are set.

claims.claim: Users must belong to at least one call queue to use the Queues app.
claims.quote: In order to use Queues app, your users must be in at least one Call queue.

claims.claim: Learn lists iOS and Android mobile clients as supported Queues app clients.
claims.quote: The Queues app is currently supported on Teams desktop, Mac, and Virtualized Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) clients, Teams phones (touch devices only), and iOS and Android mobile clients.

claims.claim: Supervisor access involves authorized-user setup.
claims.quote: Admins can now delegate authorized users, also known as leads or supervisors, to manage and configure Call queues and Auto attendants directly from the Teams client.

claims.claim: The template permission control is in Teams admin center at Voice > Templates and resources > Templates > Shared call history > Add > Incoming missed calls permission.
claims.quote:
go to **Voice** > **Templates and resources**.
2. Select **Templates**.
3. Select **Shared call history** as the template type.
4. Select **Add** to create a new Shared Call History template.

claims.claim: New-CsSharedCallHistoryTemplate supports -Name <String> -Description <String> -IncomingMissedCalls AuthorizedUsersAndAgents -AnsweredAndOutboundCalls AuthorizedUsersOnly to create the stated visibility settings.
claims.quote: New-CsSharedCallHistoryTemplate -Name "Customer Service" -Description "Missed:All Answered:Auth" -IncomingMissedCalls AuthorizedUsersAndAgents -AnsweredAndOutboundCalls AuthorizedUsersOnly

claims.claim: The cited setup steps assign a template at Teams admin center > Voice > Call queues > call queue > General info > Shared call history template, with the documented Templates discrepancy explicitly noted.
claims.quote:
go to **Voice** > **Call queues**.
2. Select the call queue you want to have shared call history for.
3. On the **General info** tab, scroll to find the **Shared call history template** section.

claims.claim: Set-CsCallQueue -Identity <Guid> -SharedCallQueueHistoryTemplateId <String> assigns a shared call history template to a queue.
claims.quote:
Set-CsCallQueue
    -Identity <Guid>

The SharedCallQueueHistoryTemplateId parameter indicates the Shared Call History template to apply to the call queue.

claims.claim: The shared call history setup page's August 17, 2026 change log says assignment moved to Templates.
claims.quote:
August 17, 2026
    - Assigning templates to a call queue has moved to the new **Templates** step.

claims.claim: The call queue creation guide places shared call history template assignment in the Templates step.
claims.quote:
#### Step 7: Templates

##### Set the Shared call history for call queue template (optional)

Select an existing template from the drop-down or Create a new template.

claims.claim: The Queues app can be turned off org-wide at Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > Actions > Org-wide app settings > Microsoft apps > Off.
claims.quote: Navigate to **Teams apps** > **Manage apps**. Select **Actions** > **Org-wide app settings** > **Microsoft apps**. Select **Off** and **Save**.

claims.claim: The documented org-wide Microsoft apps switch also turns off apps such as Insights and Tasks.
claims.quote: You can turn off the Queues app via the Teams admin center. However, doing so also turns off other Microsoft apps like Insights and Tasks.

claims.claim: Learn's general planning page gives a shared call history window of the last 3,000 entries or 6 months of calls per call queue.
claims.quote: Shared Call History shows the last 3,000 entries, or 6 months of calls, per auto attendant or call queue.

claims.claim: The supplied notice names no new identity or permission model for mobile.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Queues shared call history mobile administrative settings identity permissions template licensing price. Read MC1556098 in full and the cited template and Queues app pages; the notice specifies the same administrative settings, not a new identity model.

claims.claim: The shared call history template form contains Incoming missed calls permission and Answered and outbound calls permission settings.
claims.quote:
7. Select the appropriate **Incoming missed calls permission** level.
8. Select the appropriate **Answered and outbound calls permission** level.
